entities.name: Siege of Thraben
entities.description: Zombie assault on the High City of Thraben by Gisa and Geralf Cecani.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Last true sanctuary of humanity on Innistrad.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Necromancer who unleashed tireless dead against Thraben's gates.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Necromancer who infiltrated Thraben and murdered Mikaeus.

entities.name: Grimgrin
entities.description: Monstrous creature sent against Thraben's walls.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Leader of Thraben's guardians who set the outer ring ablaze.

entities.name: Mikaeus the Lunarch
entities.description: Lunarch and cousin of the Cecani, stabbed to death by Geralf.

entities.name: Volpaig
entities.description: Bishop and secret leader of the Skirsdag Cult, slain by Liliana.

entities.name: Skirsdag Cult
entities.description: Demon-worshipping cult led secretly by Volpaig.

entities.name: Lothar
entities.description: Guardian of Thraben who died in a madness-fueled fall.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel who is missing during the siege.

events.summary: Geralf and Gisa unleash hordes of ghouls, skaabs and Grimgrin on Thraben's walls.
events.quote: The Siege of Thraben saw Geralf and Gisa unleash vast hordes of ghouls , skaabs , and the monstrous Grimgrin

events.summary: Geralf infiltrates the city to murder Mikaeus while Gisa's dead batter the gates until the main wall falls.
events.quote: until the main wall finally fell

events.summary: Thalia burns the outer ring using stolen thatch, incinerating the undead and halting the siege.
events.quote: Thalia set the outer ring ablaze using stolen thatch from Thraben’s rooftops

events.summary: Liliana tracks down Volpaig for information on Griselbrand and slays him after he accidentally reveals only Mikaeus knew where Griselbrand was.
Lothar dies in a madness-fueled fall from the ramparts.
events.quote: Lothar , the venerable Guardian of Thraben, perished in a madness-fueled fall from the high ramparts.

events.summary: Geralf stabs Mikaeus to death; he is secretly entombed beneath the Cathedral.
events.quote: After being personally stabbed to death by Geralf, Mikaeus was secretly entombed beneath the Cathedral

events.summary: Liliana exhumes Mikaeus's corpse and learns Griselbrand is imprisoned within the Helvault.
events.quote: forcing it to reveal that Griselbrand was imprisoned within the Helvault

relations.quote: the necromantic siblings Gisa and Geralf Cecani
After being personally stabbed to death by Geralf

relations.note: slain after he refused to betray Griselbrand

relations.quote: secretly the leader of the demon-worshipping Skirsdag Cult
